simple.meaning: סִרְיֹן (çiryôn) is a Hebrew word meaning “a coat of mail.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: סִרְיֹן (H5630) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Jeremiah 46:4, with occurrences in Jeremiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to סִרְיֹן (H5630) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in סִרְיֹן (H5630) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: סִרְיֹן (çiryôn) / H5630 is traced through Jeremiah 46:4, Jeremiah 51:3 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
